scope: Standing Lalbagh Fort precinct: the Tomb of Bibi Pari, western mosque, Dewan-i-Aam with hammam, southern ramparts and the monumental southeast gate.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Bangladesh’s nomination records the principal surviving structures, gate and bastion typologies, documented outer and inner south rampart heights and the central connected gardens.
Three fluted bulbous domes, the larger central dome, corner octagonal turrets and east-facing cusped openings establish the mosque form. Exterior dimensions are about 20.35 x 10.21 m.
The audience hall has two stories, single-story hammam west of it, a Bengal do-chala roof profile and triple upper openings.
Bibi Pari’s 60 ft square tomb stands on a raised platform with four octagonal corner turrets and an octagonal copper-covered central dome.
